fields.description: The branch this window applies to. Taken from the quotation's Branch, or the first branch on the user's Sales Person.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Window opens. The check uses the server clock at the moment of saving.
fields.label: From Time

fields.description: Window closes. Both ends are inclusive.
fields.label: To Time

fields.description: Tick to make this window a Quotation window. Only ticked rows are used when a quotation is created; if a branch has several, being inside any one of them is enough.
fields.label: Quotation

fields.description: Tick to make this window a Sales Order window. Only ticked rows are used when a sales order is created. Independent of the Quotation tick.
fields.label: Sales Order
